maya: quick heads-up — ran the nightly anchor-scan and found 3 broken anchors in guides/runtime/kv-reference.md. they look like stale fragments (e.g. #kv-cache-404) and a couple of internal links from the runtime examples. who owns this page?

samir: saw some noise from the scan too. i did a quick grep locally: `rg "#kv-" docs/guides/runtime/kv-reference.md` and got duplicates + one malformed anchor.

kelly: i don't own that doc yet, but i can pick it up if no one else has bandwidth. is this a tiny fix? :+1:

maya: yeah small. proposed plan: (1) pick canonical anchors, (2) update any runtime examples that reference the old fragments, (3) add a one-line entry to the runbook about redirects (so we don't regress), (4) add a tiny CI anchor-check to catch this next time.

alex: i can open a PR with the anchor fixes + CI check. will try to bundle the examples update too.

samir: thanks! if you want me to run the scan against the PR branch i can. also suggest running `node scripts/anchor-check.js` locally before pushing.

docs-bot: anchor-scan result for 1758129999: 3 failures detected in guides/runtime/kv-reference.md — details: https://ci.internal.redwood/anchors/1758129999

kelly: assigning to @alex for the quick patch. i'll do a follow-up pass on the example snippets after his PR lands.

maya: small reminder — if you take ownership please set `owner: platform` in the frontmatter so the owners sweep picks it up.

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4811 — includes anchor replacements and a CI job that mirrors the nightly anchor-scan. PR description has the sed used: ```sed -E 's/#kv-cache-404/#kv-cache-setup/g' guides/runtime/kv-reference.md```

samir: nice. i'll run the branch scan now and push any minor snippet tweaks as suggested.

alex: pushed one follow-up commit to add the runtime-example fix and a note in the runbook redirect section.

maya: perfect — i'll wait for CI. if green i'll close the ops ticket and mark the doc owner. thanks all :rocket:

kelly: thanks — will glance at the PR later and add a short review.

alex: ok all green, merged. updated frontmatter to `owner: platform`. tagging in the handbook channel for visibility.

maya: awesome, closing the ops ticket now. great teamwork! :tada:
